description.value:
Area up to 4 non-overlapping 20-foot bursts

Beelike elementals made of pure electricity swarm out of countless portals. When you Cast the Spell and the first time you Sustain the spell each subsequent round, creatures in the area take 6d12 piercing damage and @Damage[3d6[persistent,electricity]] damage and must attempt a Fortitude save. The first time you Sustain the spell each subsequent round, you can also move one of the bursts 15 feet in any direction, though you can't move bursts so they overlap.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Suppressed] for 1 round.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is suppressed for as long as it takes the persistent damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is suppressed and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Clumsy]{Clumsy 2} for as long as it takes the persistent damage.

Heightened (+1) The piercing damage increases by 1d12.
